units.source_text: 此时六条妃子已从左卫门府回到私邸，便悄悄地启信阅读。

en.t: By this time Lady Rokujo had returned from the Left Gate Guard Office to her private residence, where she quietly opened the letter and read it.

units.source_text: 只因心怀鬼胎，读了源氏公子隐约暗示之语，立刻分明觉察。

en.t: Because she had a guilty conscience, as soon as she read Prince Genji's veiled hints, she understood them clearly at once.

units.source_text: 她想：“原来他全都知道了！”

en.t: She thought, "So he knows everything after all!"
She was deeply distressed and full of regret.

units.source_text: 又想：“我身之不幸，实无限量！

en.t: Then she thought, "The misfortune of my life is truly beyond measure!

units.source_text: 赢得了‘生魂祟人’这个恶名，不知桐壶爷听到了作何感想。

en.t: Now I have earned the vile name of a living spirit that curses others; I wonder what Lord Kiritsubo will think when he hears of it.

units.source_text: 亡夫前皇太子与桐壶爷乃同胞兄弟，情谊十分深厚。

en.t: My late husband, the former Crown Prince, and Lord Kiritsubo were brothers born of the same mother, and their bond was very deep.

units.source_text: 亡夫弥留之际，曾将女儿斋宫恳切托孤于桐壶爷。

en.t: When my husband was on his deathbed, he earnestly entrusted our daughter, the Ise Priestess, to Lord Kiritsubo's care.

units.source_text: 桐壶爷常言‘我必代弟照拂此女’，又屡屡劝我仍居宫中。

en.t: Lord Kiritsubo often said, 'I will look after this girl in my brother's place,' and repeatedly urged me to remain at court.

units.source_text: 我因守寡之身，不宜沾染红尘，故而出宫离居。

en.t: But as a widow, I felt it was improper for me to be entangled in worldly affairs, so I left the palace and lived apart.

units.source_text: 不料遇此稚龄狂童，堕入迷离春梦，平添忧愁苦恨，终于流传如此恶名。

en.t: Unexpectedly, I encountered this reckless young boy, fell into a bewildering dream of love, added only sorrow, suffering, and resentment to my life, and at last such an evil reputation spread about me.

units.source_text: 她心思缭乱，精神异常颓丧。

en.t: Her thoughts were in turmoil, and her spirit was extraordinarily dejected.
